title: An Update on the Future of Viumo 🚀

blocks.content:
Dear Viumo Family,

We've officially hit a major milestone — Viumo is now fully featured and stable! With the core platform matured, our development focus is shifting from rapid feature drops to long-term reliability and maintenance.

Rest assured: Viumo isn't going anywhere. The platform remains under active maintenance to keep your streaming smooth and uninterrupted.

Viumo has always been a free, passion-driven project, and that won't change. To help cover growing server costs, we may introduce light, non-intrusive ads — designed to keep the platform running without disrupting your experience. You'll always have control over your viewing experience, and we'll keep it that way.

If you'd like to support us directly, voluntary contributions are always appreciated. 🤝

And if you're a developer who believes in what we're building and wants to help expand Viumo, we'd love to connect.
